title: Geometric irreducibility and purely transcendental extensions
statement: Let $K/k$ be a geometrically irreducible field extension [def-pc-field-extension] [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. For every finite algebraically independent family $t_1,\ldots,t_r$ over $K$, the extension $K(t_1,\ldots,t_r)/k(t_1,\ldots,t_r)$ is geometrically irreducible. Conversely, if this holds for one transcendental variable, then $K/k$ is geometrically irreducible.
